name: Create regular email campaign
description: Call this when you need to create a new regular (non‑automated) email campaign in Brevo. Use the scheduled‑campaign setup action instead when the campaign should be sent at a future date/time.

camp_name.description: The name of the campaign to be created.

folder_path.description: The path of the folder where the campaign will be stored. Use an empty string for the root folder.

tag_ids.description: A list of tag identifiers to associate with the campaign.

outputs.description: Details of the newly created campaign, such as its identifier.

side_effects: A new regular email campaign is added to the account.
